performance_case.causal_mechanism: A causally frozen D-1 expiry-futures inventory followed by complete confirmed D-day futures and index atoms may reveal derivatives crowding before a later BTC spot DRA admission decision, but only if Unix isolation and the one-way chain prevent retrospective instrument selection and same-day leakage.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This read-only audit may freeze only a deployment architecture and ordered bounded implementation slices. It cannot prove endpoint reliability, Unix enforcement, deployment, source registration, first future evidence, prediction, fees, slippage, matched-capital PnL, drawdown improvement, candidate readiness, OOS or Trading authority.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. Any future drawdown reduction remains MISSING_PROOF until the lawful prospective carry chain supports a separately preregistered matched-capital Validation and sealed OOS result.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: Detecting a missing prior-inventory transport or unsafe shared identity before packaging prevents deployment of causally unusable evidence and avoids consuming the limited server and Local Research capacity on a source that cannot support a valid performance test.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The isolation audit cannot improve fee-adjusted total PnL directly, but a correct single-clock D-1/D+1/D+2 architecture reduces learning latency and evidence-integrity failure when accepting or rejecting the carry-conditioned DRA admission mechanism.
